constraints_found.constraint: Craving: sushi (cold food, it's hot out)
constraints_found.source_line: SUSHI. way too hot out for anything warm. let's do it!!
sushi yes. fancy sushi no. one dollar sign max, the trip fund is non-negotiable
Sushi works for me. One rule, as always: I'm allergic to peanuts. Some rolls come with peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on top, so please check.

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, needs real vegetarian rolls, not just sides (strict diet, deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: mina. you're vegetarian. rice and edamame is a side, not a lunch (maya); confirmed by cyrus: 'We need somewhere with proper vegetarian rolls, not just a side dish.' and mina: 'a few veggie rolls to choose from would be really nice.'

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance, nothing creamy (costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: ok i'm so ready. oh, small thing, nothing creamy in mine pls. dairy and i don't get along

venue_analysis.downtown_koi_counter: $, sushi, no peanuts, full meat-free roll section, no milk/cream/cream cheese. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_analysis.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on rolls and peanut dipping sauce: fails Cyrus's allergy. Deal-breaker.
venue_analysis.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, fish-stock miso: nothing for vegetarian Mina. Deal-breaker.
venue_analysis.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and creamy mayo on nearly everything, veggie rolls included: misses Roxy's dairy intolerance, 2 stars.
venue_analysis.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over Maya's $ budget: 2 stars. Otherwise meets everything.

notes: Puzzle is fair and solvable; each decoy fails exactly one constraint, which is clean design.
Mina tries to downplay her own diet ('i'm easy, rice and edamame'); Maya and Cyrus correct her. Nice misdirection, but it is resolved right away in the chat, so it is not very hard.
Koi Counter's reviews tick every box explicitly (veg section, no peanuts, no dairy, under ten bucks), which makes the answer close to obvious once you've read all five reviews.
Two decoys (Hinoki at 2 stars, Cedar Line at 2 stars) are plausible near-misses, so a careless player could still lose a star.
Minor: 'nothing creamy' plus 'dairy' could be read as also excluding mayo (not dairy). It doesn't change the answer here, since Hinoki also has cream cheese.
